title: AIT International Training on Climate-Resilient Digital Agriculture (2027)
title_zh: AIT 气候韧性数字农业国际培训（2027）
location_zh: 泰国亚洲理工学院校区

funding.evidence: The official application form states that AIT provides no scholarships or financial assistance for this training.

eligibility: Open to graduate students, researchers, faculty and agricultural practitioners, among others.
notes: Self-funded, USD 1,350. The fee includes campus accommodation, meals, local transport and field visits. AIT's official page links to the registration form. The course includes practical exercises and field demonstrations.
notes_zh: 自费 1,350 美元，含校内住宿、餐食、当地交通和实地参访。面向研究生、研究人员、教师和农业从业者等，包含实践操作与田间演示。报名表见官网。

title: ACS Green and Sustainable Chemistry Summer School 2027
title_zh: ACS 绿色与可持续化学暑期学校（2027）
location_zh: 美国伯灵顿，佛蒙特大学

funding.evidence: The American Chemical Society covers all eligible travel and program costs.

eligibility: Graduate students and postdoctoral chemists and engineers studying at institutions in the Americas or Caribbean. A nomination letter is required.
notes: For graduate students and postdocs at institutions in North, Central or South America or the Caribbean. A nomination letter is required. ACS covers eligible travel and programme costs, including campus accommodation and meals.
notes_zh: 面向就读或任职于北美、中美、南美或加勒比地区机构的相关研究生和博士后，需推荐信。ACS 承担符合条件的差旅和项目费用，包括校内住宿和餐食。
